_about: Published T-RODNet recipe, transcribed from the reference implementation Zhuanglong2/T-RODNet (configs/config_T_Rodnet_win16.py train_cfg/test_cfg/model_cfg and tools/train.py:129-167): Adam lr 1e-4 weight_decay 0, CosineAnnealingLR over the 100 epochs stepped once per epoch, batch 4, 16-frame windows at train stride 4 and test stride 8, MSE on the raw network output (the paper's text says smooth-L1; the code that produced its numbers uses nn.MSELoss), RODNet post-processing with max_dets 20, peak and OLS thresholds 0.3. The reference keeps no validation set and reports its final checkpoint on four held-out training sequences, so no test_checkpoint is set: the final epoch's weights are what gets tested.
_split_note: The authors' split (their README): test = 2019_04_09_BMS1001, 2019_04_30_MLMS001, 2019_05_23_PM1S013, 2019_09_29_ONRD005; train = the other 36 labelled ROD2021 sequences. scripts/smoke_sweep.py --split trodnet builds it, with the four test sequences also serving as the per-epoch monitor (val).
